headline: Profit climbs on wider margins as capex-driven debt rises
summary_short: WEC Energy Group's Q2 2026 revenue rose 2.6% y/y to $2,062.1M and net income attributable to common shareholders grew to $299.2M ($0.91 diluted EPS) from $245.4M ($0.76) a year ago, as operating income rose 6.9% y/y; the company reaffirmed its FY2026 EPS guidance of $5.51-$5.61.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue rose 2.6% y/y to $2,062.1M as retail electricity deliveries were roughly flat (weather-normal volumes, excluding the Michigan iron-ore mine and Very Large Customers, rose 1.2%). Operating income grew 6.9% y/y to $432.8M and net income attributable to common shareholders rose to $299.2M ($0.91 diluted EPS) from $245.4M ($0.76) a year ago. First-half capital expenditures accelerated to $2,079.9M from $1,530.5M, funded partly by $1,804.2M of new long-term debt issuance against $1,189.1M of retirements, pushing long-term debt to $19,216.3M from $17,110.4M y/y. Cash rose to $50.0M from $23.0M. WEC reaffirmed full-year 2026 EPS guidance of $5.51-$5.61, assuming normal weather for the rest of the year.

drivers.explanation: Retail electricity deliveries were roughly flat; weather-normal deliveries (ex. Michigan iron-ore mine and Very Large Customers) rose 1.2%, with large C&I usage up 0.9% and residential down 1.1%.
Basic EPS growth mirrors net income's 21.9% y/y increase, only partly offset by a 1.7% rise in basic weighted-average shares outstanding.
Diluted EPS growth mirrors net income's 21.9% y/y increase, only partly offset by a 2.1% rise in diluted weighted-average shares outstanding.
Revenue grew 2.6% y/y while total operating expenses rose only 1.5%, including a slight decline in cost of sales, expanding operating income.
Tracks the same dynamic as operating income: revenue growth outpacing a smaller rise in operating expenses.
Reflects the same revenue-over-expense dynamic as operating income, with depreciation and amortization added back.
Higher operating income combined with other income rising to $61.5M from $26.5M and a smaller net other expense, partly offset by higher interest expense ($228.9M vs $220.8M).
Higher pretax income was only partly offset by income tax expense rising to $27.0M from $19.5M, keeping the effective rate low relative to the pretax gain.
H1 net cash from operating activities of $2,210.7M slightly exceeded investing outflows of $2,200.5M, with financing activities roughly breakeven, lifting cash modestly.
H1 2026 long-term debt issuance of $1,804.2M exceeded retirements of $1,189.1M, funding capital expenditures that rose to $2,079.9M from $1,530.5M.
Retained earnings grew as H1 net income of $1,107.1M exceeded dividends paid of $620.3M, partly offset by minor other-comprehensive-loss movement.
Reflects a $398.8M common-stock issuance completed in H1 2025 that is fully embedded in the H1 2026 weighted-average share base but only partially in the year-ago period.

Management attributed results to customer service, financial discipline, and operating efficiency while continuing to execute its capital plan; the company also reaffirmed full-year 2026 EPS guidance of $5.51-$5.61 assuming normal weather.

confidence_notes: Force-regenerate mode was requested for this run (Step-0's 'already exists' guard was to be skipped and the summary written as an overwrite); in practice no prior WEC_US_FY2026_Q2.json existed on disk, so this is a first generation for this period, not a true overwrite of prior content. scripts/resolve-edgar-exhibit.mjs found no file literally prefixed 'EX-99' in the accession folder (candidates: a2026q2wecearningsreleasee.htm, R1.htm, wec-20260729.htm), but a2026q2wecearningsreleasee.htm is internally labeled 'Exhibit 99.1' and is the full Q2 2026 earnings press release with income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow tables, so it was fetched directly instead of the 8-K cover page (wec-20260729.htm). The release contains no MD&A-style causal narrative beyond one paragraph on retail electricity delivery volumes and a brief CEO quote, so income-statement drivers (operating income, EBIT, EBITDA, pretax income, net income) are marked derived-arithmetic from the release's own tables rather than company-disclosed. gross_profit_usd_m (Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries) does not reconcile to the release's own 'cost of sales' line (revenue $2,062.1M minus cost of sales $555.6M = $1,506.5M vs. the shard's $889.4M gross profit), so no cause was attributed to that KPI beyond 'not explained in the release'; the current-portion-of-long-term-debt decline is likewise not explicitly explained in the release. The company reaffirmed FY2026 EPS guidance of $5.51-$5.61 with explicit 'reaffirming' language (move=held); no next-quarter revenue/EPS guidance was given, so the guidance_revenue_next_q / guidance_eps_next_q extended metrics were omitted. capex_total and sale_of_assets_usd extended metrics are six-month YTD figures (the release does not break out quarterly capex separately), marked as such in their source section.
